source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of thermoregulation in humans (PDF 8-11).

blocks.text: Insaan endothermic homeotherms hain aur negative feedback se darja-e-hararat qaboo karte hain. Jild ke thermoreceptors barhne ya girne ko pakar kar hypothalamus ko signal dete hain, jis mein bhi thermoreceptors hain; hypothalamus muscles aur glands ko durusti ka signal deta hai. Thermoreceptors dimagh ke bulandtar markazon ko bhi signal dete hain, to hum garmi ya thand mehsoos kar ke amal karte hain, maslan nahana ya pankha ya heater chalana.

blocks.caption: Insani rad-e-amal
rows: vasodilation: jild ke neeche capillaries phailti, sateh ke qareeb zyada khoon behta aur hararat khota hai
vasoconstriction: jild ko kam khoon jata, to kam hararat zaya hoti hai
paseena: paseene ki bukhaarat hararat le jati hai
kaampna: skeletal muscles ka jhatkedar sukarna hararat banata hai
thyroid kam thyroxine nikal sakta, basal metabolic rate aur hararat kam karta
goosebumps: baalon ke muscles sukarte aur khare baal insulating hawa rokte; metabolism barhta hai

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: meethe pani ki machhli jis mein pani andar aata, bohat sa patla peshab nikalta aur namak active transport se liya jata hai. Oopar daen: samundari haddi wali machhli jis se pani nikalta, samundari pani piya jata, thora gaarha peshab aur chloride cells namak bahar nikalte hain. Neeche baen: ammonia, urea aur uric acid aur fi gram taqreeban 500, 50 aur 1 mL pani bars ki shakal mein. Neeche daen: zyada garmi aur thand mein insani rad-e-amal.
blocks.caption: Osmoregulation, nitrogeni fuzlaat aur insani thermoregulation (topics 13.2 aur 13.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Meethe pani ki machhli apne aas paas ke pani se zyada namkeen hoti hai, to pani osmosis se andar aata rehta aur namak bahar nikalta hai; yeh bohat sa patla peshab banati, namak active transport se wapas leti aur kam hi pani peeti hai. Samundari haddi wali machhli samundari pani se kam namkeen hoti hai, to pani khoti aur namak hasil karti hai; yeh samundari pani peeti, thora gaarha peshab banati aur gills ke chloride cells se namak bahar nikalti hai. Ammonia ko mehfooz taur par nikalne ke liye fi gram taqreeban 500 mL pani, urea ko 50 mL aur uric acid ko 1 mL chahiye, to pani ki kami wale janwar urea ya uric acid nikalte hain. Insani jism zyada garam ho to jild ki nalyan phailti aur paseena thanda karta hai; zyada thanda ho to nalyan sukarti, muscles kaanpte aur baal khare hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Darja-e-hararat 37 C se barhne par insanon ki qaboo ki tadabeer bayan kijiye.
blocks.explanation: Jild ke thermoreceptors hypothalamus ko signal dete; jild ki capillaries phailti hain to zyada hararat nikalti, paseene ke glands paseena banate jis ki bukhaarat jism ko thanda karti, aur hararat kam karne ke liye thyroxine ka ifraz kam ho sakta hai; saye mein jana ya pankha chalana bhi madad deta hai.

items: Garmi: vasodilation, paseena, kam thyroxine. Thand: vasoconstriction, kaampna, goosebumps, zyada metabolism. Qaboo: hypothalamus, negative feedback.
